title: Kaya Session Volume Weekly Trend
dataSources: Kaya sessions (`kaya:session`), MoonBoard sessions (`moonboard:session`), Tension Board sessions (`tensionboard:session`), 8a.nu sends (`eighta:send`), hangboard protocols (`hangboard:protocol`).
app: Kaya app sessions, MoonBoard and Tension Board logs, 8a.nu send history, and hangboard protocol trackers streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=kaya:session
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(problems_completed) as total_value avg(problems_completed) as avg_value count as sessions by _time
| sort - _time
description: Trends problems completed week by week so you can see whether kaya session volume is building, fading, or plateauing.
value: A weekly view turns isolated workouts or events into a training signal, making it easier to spot whether kaya session volume is moving in the right direction.
implementation: Forward kaya session volume into `index=personal`, keep `problems_completed` populated, and review the weekly trend before planning the next block.
visualization: Line chart of weekly total and average problems completed.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how kaya session volume changes from week to week so you can tell whether training or racing is moving the right way.
